title: workspace project list
description: Stdout of `workspace project list --json`: the projects of the workspace with their checkouts on this machine, sorted by code.

projects.description: One row per project folder of the workspace.

project_id.description: Code of the project (the name of its folder).

name.description: Display name; null when project.json is invalid.

status.description: The status of project.json, or invalid when it cannot be read.

bound.description: Whether a checkout of the project is bound on this machine.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the bound checkouts; empty when not bound.

error.description: Code of the failure to read project.json; present only when the status is invalid.
